description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React app by creating a root DOM node and rendering the App component within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element tree into the DOM.
